visible.author: Sean
visible.title: American Truck - RC Leveling Struts
visible.body: Ride quality is as good as stock, bad review is because my 33" tires were rubbing and American Truck recommended these to stop the rubbing, and it didn't fix the issue. So, I'm out $350 for product plus $650 for installation. 2 stars only given because they gave $80 dollars in store credit as it would cost wayyy too much to take off just to get $350 back.

visible.author: KJosh
visible.title: 2024 Silverado LT - Leveling Struts
visible.body: Shipped and received quickly. Packaged well. Took my cousin and I 2hr 45min to install. Not a hard install, but it is helpful to have an extra set of hands. Didn’t use any special tools, but you definitely learn small tricks by doing the first one side like using a jack to reconnect the upper control arm. After install, took around to block to check for no sounds and make sure everything compressed. Before install, top around of wheel well was at 37-1/2”. After install and driving, top of wheel well is at 39-3/4”. Can feel a difference from the factory Ranchos - softer/cushiony feel over bumps. Been driving on them for a week and glad I installed them. Overall very satisfied with the product.
visible.product: Rough Country Suspension 2-Inch Strut Leveling Kit (19-26 Silverado 1500, Excluding Trail Boss & ZR2)

visible.author: Curtis2011
visible.title: Very happy
visible.body: Went with the struts over the strut spacers and glad I spent the extra money. Had them installed by an Off-road shop so I cant speak on the install process. Ride is better than the factory ranchos. Nose is slightly higher than the rear of my 24 RST but I knew that would happen based on research. Already ordered a MotoFab 1 inch block to bring up the rear a little. 5 stars.
